faq.a: Our venue's address is 5843 Dick Pond Rd. Myrtle Beach, SC 29588. We are located next to the Historic Socastee Swing Bridge in the Southern part of Myrtle Beach. We share a parking lot with River City Cafe.

quotes.author: Megan Bell
quotes.text: We booked a wakeboarding boat ride as part of our bachelorette weekend, and it ended up being one of the absolute highlights of the entire trip! Dan was our instructor/captain/hype man/all-around legend. None of us had ever wakeboarded before, and he somehow managed to coach us all individually. The boat was perfect — clean, spacious, and had great music. If you're planning a bachelorette, birthday, or just want a super fun day on the water — this is it.

quotes.author: Joshua Mudse
quotes.text: We were in Myrtle Beach for a company retreat and wanted a water based team experience. The jet ski tour with Danny and Island Adventure Watersports was the highlight of our week. The brand new machines were only topped by Danny's expert guidance. The scenery was absolutely breathtaking. We were fortunate to see two gators sunbathing. A quick stop at Sandy Island to see the 600 year old live oak was a nice bonus. 10/10 highly recommend.

quotes.author: Kim Nickle
quotes.text: We had the BEST time!!! My husband and I and 3 boys agreed that this was the best part of our vacation. We did the 2-hour tour. Our guides were very knowledgeable about the watercraft and of all the nooks and crannies of the Intracoastal Waterway. Touring the back waters was a fabulous way to spend the day. We saw a few shipwrecks and plenty of wildlife.

quotes.author: Angela Desai
quotes.text: I would've paid double looking back!!! You will experience the most beautiful scenery imaginable while on these back trails and uniquely special open waterways! We felt like it was our very own private tour! We had speeds of up to 50mph on the calmest water ever. The perk of all perks was stopping at sand island! An UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE!

quotes.author: Jim Murphy
quotes.text: We are Myrtle Beach residents and always wanted to explore the river side of our area. We took the 2 hour backwater jet ski tour and were absolutely thrilled. Austin was a great guide and took us through back channels that we would have never found on our own. This will be our go to activity when hosting family and friends!

quotes.author: laceykg
quotes.text: Our whole family had so much fun doing this! It was two adults driving with our 8 and 10 year olds as passengers. The jet skis are in great condition. Our guides, Dave and Grant, were awesome — super helpful and laid back but also very diligent about keeping our group safe. Could not recommend this activity more!
